phase: Phase 5 — Optimization, Cost, Energy & Response Time

edge_case_tests.input_conditions: Synthetic steady CPU 50.0% (predicted: 50.0%, raw LSTM sample: 0.006912)
edge_case_tests.expected_behavior: MAINTAIN current allocation without false scaling
edge_case_tests.explanation: Predicted CPU 50.0% is within the [18%, 87%] hysteresis deadband, maintaining allocation.

edge_case_tests.expected_behavior: SCALE_UP proactive capacity expansion before peak
edge_case_tests.explanation: Predicted CPU 90% exceeded high threshold 87%, triggering proactive scale-up.

edge_case_tests.expected_behavior: SCALE_UP or maintain maximum required capacity
edge_case_tests.explanation: High utilization capped at safeguard ceiling 0.2.

edge_case_tests.input_conditions: Synthetic current CPU 0.005, low history 0.0001, predicted low
edge_case_tests.explanation: Predicted CPU < 18% low threshold triggered controlled right-sizing scale-down.

edge_case_tests.input_conditions: Single historical observation available; LSTM sequence buffer incomplete
edge_case_tests.expected_behavior: Fallback to Random Forest model for immediate tabular prediction
edge_case_tests.explanation: Successfully invoked Random Forest fallback; generated valid forecast 0.008361.

edge_case_tests.input_conditions: Temporal gap > 30 min breaks sequence continuity
edge_case_tests.expected_behavior: Graceful fallback to RF single-step regressor without pipeline crash
edge_case_tests.explanation: Sequence gap safely resolved by falling back to tabular Random Forest forecaster.

edge_case_tests.input_conditions: Both LSTM and RF pipelines unavailable/corrupted
edge_case_tests.expected_behavior: Fallback to deterministic Rule-Based Engine using observed telemetry
edge_case_tests.explanation: Rule-Based Engine safely classified observed 90% load as OVERLOADED and triggered SCALE_UP.

edge_case_tests.input_conditions: Allocation currently at 0.001 CPU floor, predicted low CPU
edge_case_tests.expected_behavior: Suppress further SCALE_DOWN; MAINTAIN at floor bound (0.001)
edge_case_tests.explanation: Safeguard prevented scale-down below configured floor bound 0.001.

edge_case_tests.input_conditions: Allocation currently at 0.200 CPU ceiling, predicted overload
edge_case_tests.expected_behavior: Clamp capacity allocation to 0.200 CPU max bound
edge_case_tests.explanation: Allocation successfully clamped at maximum safeguard ceiling 0.2.

edge_case_tests.input_conditions: LSTM neural network raises exception or missing runtime weights
edge_case_tests.expected_behavior: Automatic secondary fallback to Random Forest regressor
edge_case_tests.explanation: Pipeline switched to secondary RF model, producing valid forecast 0.014676.

edge_case_tests.input_conditions: Random Forest model active; generates prediction for policy consumption
edge_case_tests.expected_behavior: Consume RF prediction in Policy B scaling logic seamlessly
edge_case_tests.explanation: RF prediction fed directly into Policy B threshold logic without conversion error.

edge_case_tests.input_conditions: Neither ML model available; pure reactive threshold analysis
edge_case_tests.expected_behavior: Classify state based on observed metrics and emit valid action
edge_case_tests.explanation: Rule-Based Engine correctly classified 15% load as UNDERUTILIZED and applied scale-down.
